segments.text: Morning. Can you pick up oat milk on the way home tonight?
Yeah, sure.
Thanks. I'll book the Thai place for Saturday, Mira's coming too.
Nice. Oh, and I'll call the plumber about the sink today.
Good, it kept me up half the night.
Coming up after the break, I'll show you three ways to save on groceries.
I should probably start running again at some point.
Okay quick standup. Dev, where are we on the login bug?
I'll fix the login bug before lunch, it's a token refresh thing.
Great. And the investor deck?
Priya, I'll send you the pitch deck by Friday, I just need the new numbers.
I'll set up the staging environment this afternoon.
Sorry I was slow yesterday, my migraines have been brutal this week.
No worries. Also my daughter's recital is on Thursday so I'm out after three.
Got it.
Okay, idea: what if onboarding asked people to name three friends they talk to most, so the memory starts with their people.
Hmm. Write that down later.
You have to try the dumplings here.
I've heard. How was the trip?
Amazing. Lisbon is unreal, the food, the hills, everything.
Jealous. Did you do the tram?
Twice. Oh, and can you send me that podcast you mentioned?
Yeah, I'll send it tonight.
Also I'll Venmo you for last week's dinner.
No rush.
My mom loves peonies by the way, I'm getting her some for her birthday.
Ha, so does mine.
Anyway, work's been insane, we're hiring like crazy.
Same here, honestly.
Want to split the noodles too?
Obviously.
The guy at the counter remembered my order, that's how often I come here.
That's a little sad.
It's a lot sad. Okay, I have to run, good to see you.
You too, safe flight next week.
Hey! Running to grab coffee, want anything?
I'm good, thanks.
Cool. Oh the board call got moved, did you see?
Yeah I saw.
Okay, see you in a bit.
Called the plumber, he's coming Thursday morning.
Got the oat milk.
Did you get the oat milk?
Yep, it's in the fridge.
Mum's birthday is next Wednesday, I'll order her flowers tomorrow.
Still thinking about onboarding, asking people to name their friends first feels right.
Actually I'll send Sam the podcast tomorrow instead.
Oh sure, I'll get right on cleaning the garage.
I'll be back.
